description: Show the Super Validator operations schedule from the Canton Foundation's sv-cal.canton.foundation feed: planned releases, deploys, upgrades, governance windows, freezes. Filter by environment. Canton-specific. Use when an operator asks "what is happening on MainNet next?" or "when is the next Splice cut?".

environment.description: Restrict to one environment. Omit for all.

upcoming_only.description: If true (default), only events with start_at >= today.
